openings.claim: Envelope pattern/count marks and insertion ticks may reduce memory-related omissions and distribution exchanges.
openings.discriminator: Compare incumbent, marked shared-tray kits and uncued local staging; incomplete ticked envelopes defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Alternate three matched four-kit batches within 18 minutes including preparation/audit; tally omissions, crossings and total time against samples.
openings.uncertainty: Picking versus filling cause, mark legibility, matched mixtures, staging footprint and deadline benefit remain unknown; O4 challenges tray necessity.

openings.claim: Two local lanes with counted, pattern-grouped batches, exterior identification and preclosure checks may improve completeness and speed.
openings.discriminator: Fewer crossings without better omissions/time defeats proposed benefit; easier mixtures or short-session attention could explain O4.
openings.probe: Compare two matched six-kit batches, shared versus local; verify fit, count all work within 90 minutes, correct and retain kits, stop if completion is threatened.
openings.uncertainty: Matching, footprint and scaling remain unverified; simultaneous changes confound spatial attribution.

openings.claim: Isolate staging while keeping grouping, exterior marks, checking and volunteer responsibilities identical.
openings.discriminator: Reduced crossings with unchanged/worse omissions and elapsed time defeats spatial benefit; grouping/checking remain rival causes.
openings.probe: Alternate shared/local/local/shared three-kit batches; audit before correction and tally preparation, assembly, checking and replenishment.
openings.uncertainty: Matching, opened-packet footprint, comparison overhead and remaining-work feasibility are unknown.

decision: Prefer D3 for spatial attribution; D1 tests quantity cues. All evidence is synthetic, effects untested. Preserve exact pattern quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, envelopes/supplies, no equipment/purchases, and at most 90 minutes including checks. Incumbent totals 97 minutes. Twelve-kit probes cannot establish 60 complete kits or at most one distribution correction.
